P2CG1A2.blockRangeAndFit: **(a) Registered range 1589-1723 ends inside the class doc comment.** Verified at base: moved block 1589-1709, class doc comment 1711-1723, class 1724-2049. Keeping the comment with its class is correct; the alternative orphans a doc comment. A2's block is therefore 1711-2049 (339 physical) at base d0a7dd8b6, and sits at 1579-1917 in the head binder. PR #2167 did not correct A2's text: `P2CG1A2.behavior` still reads "binder lines 1724-2049 ... 326 physical lines". A2 fit: my dependency scan of the class shows it uses only two binder declarations (IWireCampaignSocket, ICampaignSessionMembershipPort, both interfaces, both exported, type-only use) and needs these imports the new file lacks: randomUUID, ServerMatchBroadcaster, campaignEventWireFrame, CampaignPublicAppliedViewStore + readCampaignPublicAppliedView, and the types ICampaignHostRegistryEntry and CampaignApplicationResult; none of those modules reaches the binder at runtime. Estimate: 339 + roughly 15-20 import lines + 1-3 binder import lines + 16 lifecycle, about 372-380 counted lines. Inside the registered 370-410 and under 500 with margin. A2's admission must re-measure at its own baseline: block start/end lines in the post-A1 binder, physical count 339, and the counted total.
P2CG1A2.exportsAndWarning: **(b) explicit-module-boundary-types warning on exported sameAppliedView.** Verified: base 85 warnings, head 86, 0 errors both; the single new warning is this one; the binder's max-lines warning drops from 1773 to 1638 counted lines. Acceptable for a move-only slice: a return annotation would change moved text. After A2 the class is the only consumer of sameAppliedView (and of IApplicationCandidate, IApplicationView, COMMIT_ATTEMPTS, HEAD_DRIFT, preparePublicCut), so A2 can drop those six exports, which returns sameAppliedView to one line and base bytes and removes the warning. The registration's "unchanged apart from export keywords" covers that.
